VVeldoing.

VVelſpring.

VVicked and VVickednes.
All men of all degrees are VVicked, if God reſtreyne them not by his holie ſpirit. 675. b 32.
The VVicked are Gods ſeruauntes, tooles, and inſtrumentes, vvherewith hee ſerueth his owne turne iuſtly and rightfully, and yet their VVickedneſſe can not bee fathered vpon him. 36. a 45. 37. b 24. 38. a 1.
The more that God bereth with the VVicked, the more do they hardē in their ſinnes. 547. a 23.
The VVicked can not do any more or any othervviſe, than God permitteth them. 36. a 38. 37. b 41. 322 b 35.

VVill.

Gods only VVill, is vnto vs a ſufficient reaſon of all his doings. 803. a 43.

VViſdome.

VVishe.

VVit.

VVitneſſe.

VVoman.

Gods VVoorde, or the Scripture.

To receiue Gods worde, is to receiue God himſelf. 410. b 411. a b.

Men cannot barre the vvorde of god from continuing in his full ſtate. 642. b 51.
The vvickednes of mens liues ought not to diminiſh the authoritie of Gods worde. 530. b 18.

VVorkmanship.

VVorld and VVorldlings.

VVrong.

VVilyneſſe.

VVynde.
The VVyndes are Gods meſſengers. 29. b 40. 30. a 15.
